fields.description: The Brooks is a residential cluster within Sobha Sanctuary focused on movement, family activity and access to the community’s central green spine. Its Garden Villas have four bedrooms, while the Courtyard Villas provide five-bedroom layouts over three levels. These are separate plotted-home configurations, not interchangeable apartment types.

overview: The developer describes The Brooks around daily activity, green corridors and shared gathering spaces. Individual layouts differ in service rooms, roof access and circulation. Compare plot area and saleable area separately when judging the space offered by a selected villa.
research.locationNote: The own project page places The Brooks in Sobha Sanctuary, within the central green-spine setting. Nearby landmarks are not substituted for its address. No exact existing catalogue neighbourhood mapping is available.
